Người mua phải thuộc nhóm đối tượng được: Buyers must belong to the groups eligible for social housing policy under Article 76 of the 2023 Housing Law – such as low-income urban residents, workers, civil servants and public employees, and the armed forces – and meet the housing and income conditions. The application includes the registration form, confirmation of eligibility and income, confirmation of housing conditions and personal identity documents using the Ministry of Construction's forms. Social housing units are subject to resale restrictions for the period set by law, so they only suit buyers who will live in them.
